newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Cenbank closes three banks over liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Cenbank closes three banks over liquidity.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank said Thursday it closed down Banco Forteleza SA and two other small banks because of liquidity problems.

The institutions were liquidated "taking into account facts which undermine the economic and financial situation" of each bank. The other two banks were Banco Vega SA of Rio de Janeiro and Banco Empresarial of Sao Jose do Rio Preto, Sao Paulo state.
Three broking houses owned by the banks were also closed, the Central Bank said in a statement on its electronic mail system.
